groups.title: Beat 3 · ask the engine, don't read the table

beats.label: Decide seven real tool calls
beats.cue: “Same engine the runtime uses, same rules we just typed. Read is free, bun and git status are free, a write inside src is free, everything else asks — and `rm -rf` is denied, because the recipe declares that deny FIRST, above the catch-all ask. Within a layer the first matching rule wins; there is no deny-beats-ask tier, so the order on the page is the order that decides.”
beats.script: The terminal is running “Decide seven real tool calls” now; its output and exit status are the evidence for this beat. [[pause:1s]] Same engine the runtime uses, same rules we just typed. Read is free, bun and git status are free, a write inside src is free, everything else asks — and `rm -rf` is denied, because the recipe declares that deny FIRST, above the catch-all ask. Within a layer the first matching rule wins; there is no deny-beats-ask tier, so the order on the page is the order that decides.
beats.command: bun -e 'const y=Bun.YAML.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("live/crewhaus.yaml","utf8")); const {evaluate}=await import("./live/dist/node_modules/@crewhaus/permission-engine/dist/index.js"); const rs={flag:[],settings:[],yaml:y.permissions.rules.map(r=>({...r,source:"yaml"})),hooks:[],builtin:[]}; const want={"Read x.ts":"allow","Bash bun test":"allow","Bash git status":"allow","Bash curl example.com":"ask","Bash rm -rf node_modules":"deny","Write src/a.ts":"allow","Write docs/a.md":"ask"}; const t=(n,i,ro,de)=>({toolName:n,input:i,readOnly:ro,destructive:de}); const calls=[["Read x.ts",t("Read",{file_path:"x.ts"},true,false)],["Bash bun test",t("Bash",{command:"bun test"},false,true)],["Bash git status",t("Bash",{command:"git status"},false,true)],["Bash curl example.com",t("Bash",{command:"curl example.com"},false,true)],["Bash rm -rf node_modules",t("Bash",{command:"rm -rf node_modules"},false,true)],["Write src/a.ts",t("Write",{file_path:"src/a.ts"},false,true)],["Write docs/a.md",t("Write",{file_path:"docs/a.md"},false,true)]]; for(const [k,c] of calls){const got=evaluate(c,y.permissions.mode,rs); console.log(k.padEnd(26)+" -> "+got); if(got!==want[k]) throw new Error(k+": got "+got+", want "+want[k]);}'

verify.note: asserts all seven decisions against crewhaus 0.4.2's engine. The engine walks source layers in priority order and takes the FIRST matching rule inside a layer — there is no tier-first deny > ask > allow. Recipe 29 puts `alwaysDeny Bash(rm -rf**)` at the top of the list for exactly that reason. Move it below the catch-all `alwaysAsk Bash(**)` and this beat fails with ask.

beats.label: Hold the pattern grammar to its table
beats.cue: “Nine rows straight out of the recipe's grammar table. The one to remember: a single star does not cross a slash, so Bash(rm -rf *) never matches rm -rf slash.”
beats.script: The terminal is running “Hold the pattern grammar to its table” now; its output and exit status are the evidence for this beat. [[pause:1s]] Nine rows straight out of the recipe's grammar table. The one to remember: a single star does not cross a slash, so Bash(rm -rf *) never matches rm -rf slash.
beats.command: bun -e 'const {compilePattern,matchesPattern}=await import("./live/dist/node_modules/@crewhaus/tool-permission-matcher/dist/index.js"); const m=(p,t,i)=>matchesPattern(compilePattern(p),t,i); const rows=[["Read","Read",{file_path:"anything"},true],["Bash(git *)","Bash",{command:"git status"},true],["Bash(git *)","Bash",{command:"npm i"},false],["Write(**/src/**)","Write",{file_path:"pkg/src/a.ts"},true],["Write(**/src/**)","Write",{file_path:"docs/a.md"},false],["Bash(rm -rf *)","Bash",{command:"rm -rf tmp"},true],["Bash(rm -rf *)","Bash",{command:"rm -rf /"},false],["Bash(**)","Bash",{command:"rm -rf /"},true],["*__list_directory","fs__list_directory",{},true]]; for(const [p,tool,i,want] of rows){const got=m(p,tool,i); console.log(p.padEnd(18)+" vs "+tool+" "+JSON.stringify(i)+" -> "+got); if(got!==want) throw new Error(p+" vs "+tool+": got "+got);}'

verify.note: all nine rows of the recipe's pattern-grammar table hold, including `*` not crossing `/` and the MCP-namespace `*__list_directory` row

beats.label: Prove the two floors hold
beats.cue: “Plan mode denies the write with zero rules configured — and separately, a tool that declares requiresSandbox is denied outright when no sandbox is wired. Fail-closed, both times.”
beats.script: The terminal is running “Prove the two floors hold” now; its output and exit status are the evidence for this beat. [[pause:1s]] Plan mode denies the write with zero rules configured — and separately, a tool that declares requiresSandbox is denied outright when no sandbox is wired. Fail-closed, both times.
beats.command: bun -e 'const y=Bun.YAML.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("live/plan.yaml","utf8")); const {evaluateWithReason}=await import("./live/dist/node_modules/@crewhaus/permission-engine/dist/index.js"); const e={flag:[],settings:[],yaml:[],hooks:[],builtin:[]}; const m=y.permissions.mode; const d=(n,f,mo)=>evaluateWithReason({toolName:n,input:{},...f},mo||m,e); const r=d("Read",{readOnly:true,destructive:false}); const w=d("Write",{readOnly:false,destructive:true}); if(r.decision!=="allow"||w.decision!=="deny") throw new Error("plan mode did not deny the write"); console.log(m+" mode: Read -> allow, Write -> deny"); const p=d("Python",{readOnly:false,destructive:true,requiresSandbox:true},"default"); if(p.decision!=="deny") throw new Error("the sandbox floor did not hold"); console.log("default mode: Python -> deny — "+p.reason)'

verify.note: plan mode: Read -> allow, Write -> deny; default mode: Python -> deny with the requiresSandbox reason (recipe 30 is what wires the sandbox that lifts it)
